disclaimer: Context only — an AI reading of the radar's own deterministic output, not a signal. It feeds no score or allocation, can be wrong or overconfident, and every claim cites the radar evidence it is based on. Graded against the tape over time; treat as odds, not a forecast.

assessments.rationale: Real activity is meaningfully ahead of price: the divergence is 2.164, with strong government-contract and congressional net-buy signals at 1.918 and 1.964 respectively [P2][P3]. The signal spans four sources, but lobbying and material-event activity are much weaker at 0.115 and 0.56, so persistence is not yet broadly demonstrated [P3]. Price has not confirmed—the group trails the market by 7.18% over 60 days—while the setup is still forming and has no supporting news leg [P1][P4][P5]. That creates potential upside if activity persists, but the uneven source strength makes MONITOR more appropriate than immediate entry [P1][P3].
assessments.rationale_zh: 真实活动明显领先价格：活动与价格的背离为2.164，政府合同和国会议员净买入信号分别达到1.918和1.964 [P2][P3]。信号覆盖四类来源，但游说活动和重大事项活动仅为0.115和0.56，持续性尚未得到全面验证 [P3]。该板块过去60天落后大盘7.18%，当前形态仍在形成，而且没有新闻推动 [P1][P4][P5]。因此存在补涨潜力，但更适合继续观察，而非立即进场 [P1][P3]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Government contracting and congressional buying are picking up strongly across the group, while lobbying and corporate event activity show only modest improvement. Prices have not followed—the group has lagged the market by about 7% over the past 60 days—and there is no supporting news momentum yet. The gap could create an opportunity if the activity persists, but for now the prudent move is to watch for broader confirmation before buying.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 政府合同活动和国会议员买入明显升温，但游说活动及企业重大事项仅有温和改善。相关公司股价过去60天落后大盘约7%，目前也没有新闻热度配合。如果这些活动能够持续，价格可能补涨，但现阶段更适合等待更广泛的确认后再考虑买入。
assessments.dissent: The strongest bullish case is that two independent real-activity sources are already near 2 standard deviations above normal while price remains weak, making this an unusually favorable early-entry gap rather than a reason to wait [P2][P3][P4].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Upgrade toward entry if the next observation shows government contracts and congressional net buying remain elevated, lobbying or material-event activity strengthens, and 60-day relative performance begins improving [P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Avoid if government-contract and congressional buying signals fall back materially while relative performance remains negative or deteriorates, indicating the current divergence was a one-off [P2][P3][P4].

assessments.name: Communication Services (Equal-Weight)

assessments.rationale: Real activity is meaningfully ahead of price: the divergence is z=2.067 and fused acceleration is 1.438 across six sources [P2][P3]. The signal is reasonably broad—Congress net-buy (z=1.637), lobbying (z=1.236), grant opportunities (z=0.664), and material 8-K events (z=0.521) are positive—but federal contracts remain negative (z=-0.465) and news is flat (z=0.0) [P3]. Price has not confirmed the activity: 60-day relative strength is -13.66%, with a z-score of -1.549 [P4], creating an emerging activity-led entry setup [P1]. Confidence is MED because multiple sources support persistence, but the weakness in contracts and lack of accelerating news leave open the possibility that the pickup will not convert into sustained commercial activity [P3][P5].
assessments.rationale_zh: 现实活动明显领先于价格：活动与价格的偏离为2.067个标准差，综合加速度为1.438，覆盖六类来源[P2][P3]。国会净买入、游说投入、联邦资助机会和重大公司事件均呈正向，但联邦合同仍为负向，新闻流量也没有明显变化[P3]。过去60天相对大盘表现落后13.66%，说明价格尚未反映活动回升，因此目前具备活动先行的介入条件[P1][P4]。信心为中等，因为多类来源支持持续性，但合同疲弱和新闻未加速仍可能阻碍活动转化为长期商业需求[P3][P5]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Government-related and corporate activity is picking up across several channels, especially congressional buying, lobbying, grant opportunities, and material company events. Share prices have lagged the market by roughly 14% over the past 60 days, so the improvement does not appear fully reflected yet. A measured entry is warranted, though weak federal contracting and flat news activity argue against committing too aggressively.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 政府相关和企业活动正在多个渠道回升，尤其体现在国会买入、游说投入、资助机会和重大公司事件方面。相关公司股价过去60天落后大盘约14%，说明这轮改善尚未被价格充分反映。可以考虑适度介入，但联邦合同偏弱且新闻热度未明显上升，不宜过度押注。
assessments.dissent: The strongest opposing case is that the apparent pickup is not yet anchored by actual federal contract activity: contracts are negative and news is flat, while the positive readings are led by congressional buying and lobbying, which may not translate into revenue [P3].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Confirm if the next observation keeps activity ahead of price while federal contracts turn positive and at least four of the six sources remain positive or accelerate [P2][P3].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Disconfirm if fused acceleration falls to zero or below, the positive-source count drops materially, or price catches up without improvement in federal contracts and news flow [P2][P3][P4][P5].

assessments.name: Space Economy

assessments.rationale: Real activity is moderately strong: government contracting and lobbying are both elevated, while material-event activity is only slightly positive and congressional net buying is negative; the combined acceleration is strong across four sources [P3]. Persistence is plausible but unproven because the signal is still forming, its components disagree, and there is no supporting news leg [P1][P3][P5]. Price confirmation is weak: the group has outperformed the market by only 1.67% over 60 days, while activity remains ahead of price [P2][P4]. MONITOR rather than enter until either price participation or sustained multi-source activity provides confirmation [P1][P3][P4].
assessments.rationale_zh: 现实活动信号中等偏强：政府合同和游说活动明显升温，但重大事项仅略有改善，国会议员净买入则为负；四类来源合成后的加速度较强 [P3]。持续性存在可能，但尚未得到证明，因为趋势仍处于形成阶段、各项信号并不一致，而且没有相关新闻推动 [P1][P3][P5]。价格确认较弱：该组过去60天仅比大盘高出1.67%，现实活动仍领先于价格表现 [P2][P4]。因此目前宜继续观察，等待价格跟进或多类活动持续增强 [P1][P3][P4]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Government contracting and lobbying activity are picking up, but corporate event activity is only mildly positive and congressional buying points the other way. Prices have barely outperformed the market over the past 60 days, so investors have not meaningfully followed the improving activity. Keep this theme on a watchlist until the improvement persists across more indicators or prices begin to respond.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 政府合同和游说活动正在升温，但企业重大事项仅略有改善，国会议员的交易动向则相反。过去60天相关公司股价仅略微跑赢大盘，说明投资者尚未明显跟进这些改善。现阶段宜继续观察，等待更多指标持续转强或价格开始作出明确反应。
assessments.dissent: The strongest bullish case is that combined activity is already accelerating strongly across four sources, led by government contracts and lobbying, while price has barely moved; that gap could represent an early entry opportunity rather than a reason to wait [P2][P3][P4].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Confirm the thesis if subsequent readings show government contracting and lobbying remaining positive, material-event activity strengthening, and 60-day relative performance rising meaningfully above its current 1.67% [P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Disconfirm it if combined acceleration fades, government contracting or lobbying reverses, or congressional net buying remains negative while relative performance weakens from its already near-neutral level [P3][P4].

assessments.name: Consumer Staples (Equal-Weight)

assessments.rationale: Real activity is weak across all three measured sources: Congress net buying is below trend, lobbying is sharply contracting, and material 8-K activity is slightly soft [P3]. Durability is poor because the radar classifies the theme as fading, with activity materially lagging price [P1][P2]. Although 60-day relative performance remains positive, that strength is unsupported by activity or a news catalyst, suggesting price is running ahead of the narrative [P4][P5].
assessments.rationale_zh: 三项现实活动指标均偏弱：国会议员净买入低于趋势，游说活动显著收缩，重大8-K事件也略显疲软[P3]。雷达将主题判定为衰退阶段，且活动明显落后于价格，因此持续性较差[P1][P2]。尽管过去60天相对市场表现为正，但缺乏活动与新闻催化支持，价格可能已经跑在基本叙事之前[P4][P5]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Insurers and brokers have recently outperformed the market, but the activity underneath that move is weakening: political buying is below trend, lobbying has fallen sharply, and corporate event filings are slightly soft. With no supporting news catalyst, the price move appears to be running ahead of real-world momentum, so it is better to stay cautious for now.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 保险公司与经纪商近期跑赢大盘，但支撑这轮上涨的现实活动正在减弱：政治人物买入低于趋势，游说活动明显下降，企业重大事项申报也略显疲软。由于缺乏新闻催化，价格表现似乎已经领先于实际动能，目前更适合保持谨慎。
assessments.dissent: The strongest counterargument is that the combined activity measure still shows positive acceleration across three sources, while relative price strength is also positive; this could mark an early turn that the individual signed readings have not yet captured [P3][P4].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Upgrade the view if the next observation shows lobbying and congressional buying returning above trend while relative performance remains positive, demonstrating multi-source activity catching up with price [P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: The cautious verdict is reinforced if fused acceleration turns negative or remains positive only while lobbying and congressional buying stay below trend and relative price strength weakens [P3][P4].

assessments.name: Insurance & Brokers

assessments.rationale: Real activity is mixed and currently trails price materially: the activity-price divergence is -1.862 [P2], with weak congressional buying (-0.958), 8-K events (-1.751), and news flow (-0.674) offsetting stronger lobbying (0.674) and grant opportunities (0.395); government contracts are neutral [P3]. Durability is limited because the radar labels the theme fading with NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE [P1], although positive fused acceleration (0.787) across six sources leaves some recovery potential [P3]. Continuity is poor: 60-day relative strength is strong at 0.1839 while underlying activity lags [P4][P2], suggesting price has run ahead of confirmation. News is accelerating modestly and entirely unscheduled, but its signed activity signal remains negative [P5][P3].
assessments.rationale_zh: 现实活动信号喜忧参半且明显落后于价格：活动与价格的背离为-1.862 [P2]；国会议员净买入、8-K重大事项和新闻流均偏弱，而游说活动和联邦资助机会有所增强，政府合同则没有明显变化 [P3]。持续性较弱，因为雷达将该主题判定为负向背离并进入衰退阶段 [P1]；不过，六个来源的综合加速度仍为正，说明尚有一定复苏可能 [P3]。价格连续60天显著跑赢大盘，但现实活动尚未跟上，因此价格确认不足，存在预期透支风险 [P4][P2]。新闻出现小幅加速且全部为非预定事件，但整体新闻活动信号仍然偏弱 [P5][P3]。
assessments.rationale_plain: 游说活动和联邦资助机会有所增加，但企业重大事项、国会议员买入和整体新闻热度都在减弱，政府合同也没有明显起色。相关公司股价过去两个月明显跑赢大盘，现实活动却没有同步跟上，说明市场预期可能已经走在基本面之前。现阶段更适合回避，等待合同、企业事件和新闻热度出现更广泛且持续的改善。
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 游说活动和联邦资助机会有所增加，但企业重大事项、国会议员买入和整体新闻热度都在减弱，政府合同也没有明显起色。相关公司股价过去两个月明显跑赢大盘，现实活动却没有同步跟上，说明市场预期可能已经提前透支。现阶段更适合回避，等待合同、企业事件和新闻热度出现更广泛且持续的改善。
assessments.dissent: The strongest counterargument is that fused acceleration is already positive at 0.787 across six sources [P3], while news velocity is accelerating and entirely unscheduled [P5]; together these could mark an early turn before the lagging activity measures improve.

falsifiable_check.confirm: Confirm the AVOID call if the activity-price divergence remains negative or deteriorates from -1.862 while 8-K events, congressional buying, and news flow stay below neutral despite continued price outperformance [P2][P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Disconfirm it if multiple currently weak sources—especially 8-K events, congressional buying, and news flow—turn positive while lobbying and grant activity remain positive, causing activity to catch up with price [P2][P3].

assessments.name: AI Software & Platforms

assessments.rationale: Real activity is mixed and modest overall: congressional net buying (z=1.843) and federal grant FOAs (z=1.162) are positive, but government contracts are sharply weak (z=-2.258), with lobbying and 8-K activity also negative; fused acceleration is only 0.358 across five sources [P3]. Durability is limited by the fading lifecycle and negative divergence, while the absence of a news leg removes a potential near-term reinforcement [P1][P2][P5]. Price has nevertheless outperformed SPY by 9.05% over 60 days, indicating that price is ahead of the weaker real-activity signal rather than being newly validated by it [P2][P4]. MONITOR until improvement becomes broader and persistent.
assessments.rationale_zh: 现实活动信号喜忧参半且整体偏弱：国会议员净买入和联邦资助机会有所增强，但政府合同明显萎缩，游说和重大事件披露也偏弱，五类来源的综合加速幅度有限 [P3]。主题已进入减弱阶段，现实活动落后于价格，而且没有新闻推动提供短期支撑，因此持续性存疑 [P1][P2][P5]。过去60天相关资产相对大盘上涨9.05%，说明价格可能已经领先于基本活动，而不是得到其进一步确认 [P2][P4]。目前更适合观察，等待改善扩展到更多来源并持续出现。
assessments.rationale_plain: Congressional buying and new federal grant opportunities are picking up, but government contracts have fallen sharply, while lobbying and corporate event activity remain soft. Prices have already outpaced the market by about 9% over the past 60 days even though the underlying activity is weakening overall, and there is no fresh news push. It is better to watch for a sustained, wider recovery in real-world activity before acting.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 国会议员买入和新的联邦资助机会有所增加，但政府合同明显减少，游说及企业重大事项活动也较疲弱。相关资产过去60天已比大盘多涨约9%，现实活动却整体减弱，同时缺少新的消息推动。现阶段更适合继续观察，等待现实活动出现更广泛且持续的回升后再行动。
assessments.dissent: The strongest bullish countercase is that congressional net buying and federal grant opportunities are already strong, the five-source aggregate is still accelerating, and 60-day relative performance is positive; these may be early signs that the weak contract and disclosure readings will reverse [P3][P4].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Confirm the MONITOR stance if subsequent readings continue to show government contracts, lobbying, and 8-K activity below neutral while price remains ahead of real activity and no news leg develops [P2][P3][P5].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Disconfirm it if government contracts, lobbying, and 8-K activity turn positive alongside the already-positive congressional and grant signals, producing sustained multi-source acceleration while price strength persists [P3][P4].

rotation.summary: Leadership is rotating toward Financials and Non-AI Tech (CONFIRMED_UP), while early accumulation signals appear in Communication Services, Space Economy, and Consumer Staples (POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE); AI, power, nuclear, minerals, and energy-linked themes are broadly fading or confirmed down.
rotation.summary_zh: 领导力正转向金融与非AI科技（CONFIRMED_UP），通信服务、太空经济和必需消费出现活动领先价格的早期积累信号（POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE）；AI、电力、核能、关键矿产及能源相关主题普遍走弱或已确认下行。
accumulate: Communication Services (Equal-Weight): POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE, lifecycle=forming — real activity leads price.
Space Economy: POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE, lifecycle=emerging — real activity leads price.
Consumer Staples (Equal-Weight): POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE, lifecycle=forming — real activity leads price.
reduce: Insurance & Brokers: NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, lifecycle=fading — price is ahead of weakening activity.
AI Software & Platforms: NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, lifecycle=fading — price is ahead of activity.
GLP-1 & Obesity: NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, lifecycle=fading — price is ahead of activity.
Health Care (Equal-Weight): NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, lifecycle=fading — price is ahead of activity.
Housing Chain: NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, lifecycle=fading — price is ahead of activity.
AI Agents & Applications: NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, lifecycle=fading — price is ahead of activity.
Critical Minerals & Rare Earths, Uranium & Nuclear Fuel, Silver Miners, and US Energy Complex: CONFIRMED_DOWN, lifecycle=fading.
AI Neoclouds & HPC Hosting, Data-Center Power & Cooling, AI Infrastructure-adjacent Power & Grid Buildout, Nuclear & SMR Power, and Semiconductor Equipment: CONFIRMED_DOWN, lifecycle=fading.
Magnificent Seven, Memory/HBM/Storage, and Utilities (Equal-Weight): CONFIRMED_DOWN, lifecycle=fading.
watch: Financials (Equal-Weight) and Non-AI Tech & Hardware are the only CONFIRMED_UP, lifecycle=confirming leaders; deterioration from CONFIRMED_UP would weaken the rotation read.
Upgrade of Communication Services, Space Economy, or Consumer Staples from POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE to CONFIRMED_UP would validate broader leadership.
Improvement from NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE or CONFIRMED_DOWN toward POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE/CONFIRMED_UP in AI, power-grid, nuclear, minerals, or energy themes would signal reversal.
QUIET themes becoming directional could broaden or challenge the current narrow rotation.
